pairs: to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove
to transfer, to carry, to transport (somewhere)
to carry in, to bring in
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: выноси́ть — to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove; переноси́ть — to transfer, to carry, to transport (somewhere); внести́ — to carry in, to bring in; снести́ — to carry down.
